notes:
Completes the deviation set for receipt v004 alongside APR-0001, which already accepts runtime_band, sound_layers, padding, asset_reuse, retention_cadence, structure_4part and preflight_receipt. APR-0001 targeted v003 and a different render, so it does not carry forward on its own; this record names v004 and its sha.

WHY THIS RENDER EXISTS. EP57 was pulled off the 2026-08-11 slot on 2026-08-05 when check_shipped_frames.py -- which samples four frames per cut out of the finished master instead of one frame per clip off a contact sheet -- returned 96 rejections. Exactly one was in the four categories the owner still blocks: a lower-third reading 'AMY ALBRITTON / Apartment manager, Frances Place, Monroe, Louisiana' sitting over a uniformed officer and a tattooed man in inmate browns. That card and the 'L.J. SCOTT, JR.' card were removed from the filmconfig; both strings now return zero matches anywhere in fieldtest_film.json, and all 25 remaining lower-thirds carry a concept, term, date or place in the nameplate slot -- checked mechanically, not by eye. Three blocked clips were pruned. YouTube cannot swap a video's bytes, so this is a fresh upload and FOdVK1qQE6w stays private with no publishAt.

animation_density -- the film is not static; one stretch is 0.6s long. Measured on this render: BODY near-still 1.7% of a 1643s body, against a limit of 10%. The failure is the companion rule that no single near-still stretch exceed 3s, and the longest here is 3.6s. For reference the check's own MotionSample baseline is ~5.5%, so this film is roughly three times more animated than the reference it is scored against. One 3.6s stretch is a shot held slightly long, not a slideshow.

probe_receipt -- NOT waived on assertion. The receipt on file binds to film_sha256 1628da02, which is the film json from before the cards came out, so the evidence is stale and the gate is right to reject it. Instead of waiving I measured something stronger than the receipt would have held: the receipt samples a 90-second slice, and I ran blackdetect (d=0.5, pix_th=0.10) and freezedetect (n=-60dB, d=2) across the ENTIRE 1655.8s master. Result: ZERO black stretches and ZERO frozen stretches -- cleaner than EP55 burge, which shipped with one 0.933s black stretch under the same measurement. The 60-second pre-render probe also ran on this exact film and reported black 0.0s, frozen 0.0s, dark frames 3.3%. The property the receipt exists to prove holds on these bytes; what is missing is the artefact.

SHIPPED-FRAME REVIEW. runs/qc/fieldtest_shipped_frames_review.v001.json, bound to this sha, records PASS with zero hard findings across all 303 distinct sources. It states its own limit plainly: coverage_mode is per_source, not per_frame -- this session's 200-subagent budget was exhausted, so one reader compressed 71 frame sheets to 16 one-tile-per-source sheets and read all of them. That answers a real minor, scraped third-party footage and legible personal data, which are properties of a clip. It cannot answer a defect visible only between a clip's sampled points, and the review says so rather than claiming the stronger thing.

AUTHORISATION. The owner's 2026-08-06 instruction to compromise on visual quality and get every currently-private video publishable, quoted in full in the EP55 APR-0002. Four categories were held back on the owner's standing rule that the channel must never be banned: scraped third-party footage, a real identifiable minor, a real person's name card over a different real person, and legible personal data of a real private individual. None is present on this master.
